journals:JNL-A-138.summary: When many people (or a script) create manual journals at the same moment, some calls fail with HTTP 500 and others with 401 instead of all succeeding with distinct journal numbers. It was found with 30 parallel creates; 20 parallel drafts were fine. A month-end batch import or two busy accountants could lose entries.
steps: Log in and keep one valid token.
Fire 30 parallel POST /api/accounting/journal-entries/manual calls with a small balanced body (Dr 6105 10 / Cr 1111 10, documentType MANUAL_JOURNAL).
Count the status codes.
journals:JNL-A-138.expected: All 30 calls answer 201 with 30 different journal numbers.
journals:JNL-A-138.actual: Reported on release_0.0.9: 5 answered 500 and 20 answered 401. Not retested on the current backend.
journals:JNL-A-138.where: backend modules/accounting/journal: JournalEntryDomainService (number generation ~l.383, cash-in-hand lock ~l.572), TransactionSeriesConfigService.generateNextId; the 401 points at token/session handling under load, not at accounting.
journals:JNL-A-138.verify: Repeat the 30 parallel POST /api/accounting/journal-entries/manual; expect 30 x 201, journalNo all distinct, and no 401 from the same token.

journals:JNL-A-82.note: TaskService.completeTask (shared/workflow/application, ~l.362-372) returns silently with 200 when the task is already COMPLETED ('if (task.getStatus()==COMPLETED) return;'), so the controller still answers 'Task completed'. Deliberate idempotence, but the api says success for a rejected task too.
journals:JNL-A-82.summary: Completing an approval task a second time (for example Approve after it was already Rejected) answers 200 'Task completed' although nothing changed. The caller cannot tell that the second decision was ignored, so a stale screen or script believes it approved something it did not.
steps: Create a journal that needs approval and reject its task: POST /api/workflow/tasks/{taskId}/complete with the reject decision payload.
Send POST /api/workflow/tasks/{taskId}/complete again with the approve decision.
journals:JNL-A-82.expected: The second call is refused with 409 (task already completed).
journals:JNL-A-82.where: backend shared/workflow: TaskService.completeTask (~l.372 early return), WorkflowTaskController.completeTask (l.61-69)
journals:JNL-A-82.verify: POST /api/workflow/tasks/{id}/complete twice on one task; the second must return 409.

tests: ACC-11-04 (settle of an owed return, normal case only)
rv-be:accounting:3.verify: File, add a VAT journal, settle: expect 409; settle with settledDate earlier than filedDate: expect 400.
